text:
tj: Passing handoff — saw a sev2 page ~30m ago, embedding inference 503 surge in eu-west. Quick summary: autoscaler oscillation + KV cache evictions caused request failures and fallback latency spikes.
incident-bot: PAGE TRIGGERED: PAGER embedding-503-eu-west | severity: sev2 | pages: 12 | link: https://redwood.ops/pagers/embedding-503-eu-west
maria: TL;DR — scaled the eu-west embedding pool (+2 nodes), flushed local KV caches, pinned traffic to fallback-small-embed model until stable.
alex: Actions I ran: patched autoscaler minReplicas -> 3, disabled ephemeral-bursting, and applied a temporary routing policy to prefer warmed nodes.
maria: Observability notes — after scale p95 token latency dropped 1.8s -> 700ms; 503 rate dropped 4.6% -> 0.2% (rolling). KV eviction rate still elevated but trending down.
tj: Runbook referenced: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler (section 3: surge mitigation). Steps executed: 1) scale-up; 2) flush kv on primaries; 3) pin fallback model; 4) enable tighter routing. Commands used: 
```
kubectl patch hpa eu-west-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
adminctl cache flush --cluster eu-west --selector=primary
```
alex: Customer-impact check: internal integrations showed retries/errors; external customer-facing requests were low impact but some partner jobs retried. CS/Support notified and watching.
sre-lead: Please add a short blameless timeline to the incident board and capture the autoscaler metric graphs for the postmortem.
tj: Outstanding follow-ups: - Revisit autoscaler thresholds (owner: alex) - Tune cache eviction aggressiveness (owner: infra-ml) - Add pre-scale warmup to reduce cold starts.
maria: I'll monitor for the next hour and own the handoff if stable. Oncall assignment for next shift: maria (primary), alex (secondary).
tj: Handoff checklist for next shift: 
- confirm 503 <= 0.5% for 30m
- verify KV hit ratio > 85%
- confirm no new pages for routing or autoscaler errors
- clear model pin if stable
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: embedding-503-eu-west moved to MITIGATED | mitigations: scale-up, cache flush, route pin | status: MONITORING
alex: :thumbsup: I'll follow up on the autoscaler PR and post short notes to #customer-impact if anything changes.
tj: Handing off now. All details, command logs, and ticket links in the incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0453
maria: Copy — picking this up. Will escalate to sre-lead if regressions appear.
